status: passed focused tests, integrated isolated browser workflows and final-copy follow-up
scope: Original bounded A2 chapter checks, targeted catch-up and an evidence-based rolling weekly report with optional planned-day next steps.

diagnostics.coverage: One narrow question for each of 20 existing A2 topics and 9 new supplemental A2 topics. Questions use original parallel details, rather than reproducing book worksheets.
diagnostics.sourceContext: All 29 question targets resolve to maintained A2 grammar units. Those units retain their verified source references; each check also links its existing chapter transfer mission.
diagnostics.persistence: Optional validated Progress.diagnostics within the existing version 1 backup. No separate local key and no lesson-score or XP mutation.
diagnostics.firstAttemptPolicy: One run per chapter/start date. First submissions are immutable. Pending drafts and hint use persist separately. Later-date runs retain earlier first answers, including an unfinished run continued on another day.
diagnostics.retention: Maximum 400 saved runs. Starting another run is disabled at the limit with bilingual export guidance. Existing drafts and results remain available and are not automatically deleted.
diagnostics.catchUp: Incorrect or hinted samples link the earliest unfinished prerequisite, the sampled grammar unit and the existing chapter transfer task. Missing records are not labelled weaknesses.
diagnostics.limitsShown: Checks sample grammar forms; they do not certify CEFR level, assess listening/speaking or establish mastery of a whole chapter.

weeklyReport.window: Seven calendar dates ending today, inclusive.
evidence: Known lesson completions and one core recall record per lesson/date
Known grammar first answers per exercise/date, recorded help, same-day repairs and matched later-calendar-day first answers
Latest dated personal-word self-ratings and latest game records, explicitly labelled as incomplete event histories
Known self-assessed grammar production completions, actual programme.practice.completed checkpoints and exact known companion self-checks
Dated diagnostic first answers and recorded hint support
weeklyReport.identityBoundary: Unknown missions, exercises, game items, words, programmes, checkpoint indexes and companion IDs do not contribute. Companion membership is generated from 53 known source extents and parity-tested against all 1609 actual companion IDs.
weeklyReport.delayedEvidence: A later-day grammar success requires an earlier dated attempt on the same exercise and a correct first answer without recorded support on a later calendar date. Same-day repair alone is never labelled delayed improvement. Core later-day recall requires a matching earlier lesson completion.
weeklyReport.nextSteps: Existing due practice and the latest unambiguous diagnostic need provide specific links. Up to 3 existing next-step tasks are suggested on planned study weekdays in the next 7 days, respecting plan.start. Suggestions do not mutate dates, schedules or programmes.
weeklyReport.honesty: No inferred time spent, total weekly events from latest-only records, proficiency level or overall improvement. Empty windows state that no dated evidence is available, without inferring weakness.

coverage: Original bank identity, bilingual fields, known target/transfer links and accent-sensitive grading
Idempotent starts, first-answer immutability, saved drafts, hints, ordered submission and later-date continuation
Malformed imports, stale IDs, invalid dates, text bounds, feedback identity and 400-run retention

Version1 progress round-trip, original-backup compatibility and 1609 companion identity parity

browser.isolation: Owned standalone headless Chromium and disposable synthetic contexts. No shared CDP, existing learner profile, real learner records, source archive or backup contents accessed.
observations: All 10 chapter samples display. An unfinished check started two dates earlier resumes its prior draft, and a new unsubmitted response survives reload.

A wrong first answer and feedback survive reload. A second answer with a hint records support. The è accent control and pending accent survive reload; completing the check preserves ordinary academy data, lesson credit and schedules.
The sampled conditional error links the exact first missing prerequisite grammar/noun-gender. Browser Back restores the diagnostic result and its original wrong answer.

A known mixed weekly fixture shows 1/2 independent grammar first answers, 1 same-day repair and a matched later-day success, alongside 3 diagnostic first answers including 1 supported answer. Merely opening or reloading the report leaves storage unchanged.
An empty week explicitly reports absent evidence and no matching later-day success. Optional next-week links appear on planned dates without changing progress.
At 400 runs, no Start control is offered. Bilingual guidance opens normal backup tools and preserves all 400 records.
Final rebuilt copy correctly uses “1 supported answer” / “1 risposta aiutata” and neutral later-day count labels in EN at 390px and IT at 320px.
browser.visualReview: Viewed viewport-height screenshots of Italian completion/catch-up and weekly evidence, final Italian singular wording, and desktop weekly cards. Controls and metrics wrap within the sampled panels.

limitations: Synthetic UI and deterministic fixtures verify the stated paths; no real learner study or measured learning improvement was performed.
Repeated questions and short grammar samples cannot establish overall A2 competence. Listening, speaking and independent open-ended writing remain outside automatic assessment.
No complete word/game event history exists in the current progress schema; the report shows only latest dated records and explains possible overlap or trimmed history.
Only the 10 most recent chapter checks are listed in the UI; all saved runs remain in the normal progress backup.
Browser checks opened backup guidance but did not download or import a real backup. Backup validation and conflict-preserving merges have separate regression coverage owned by the integration agent.
